metadata.description: Live-captured POST /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}/deployment against a real update-catalog uuid and a disposable-OG smart group (deleted after capture). id manually restored to 0 here: the standard anonymizer's key=="id" rule unconditionally replaces any "id" field with a nonzero sequential counter value, which silently corrupted this specific field's real, meaningful value of 0 (deployments are UUID-identified, not integer-ID-identified, per this test suite's own prior-established, still-accurate finding) -- confirmed against the equivalent already-verified sibling captures in this same fixture family.
